notes.title: Terrain Update
notes.content:
​In this update we have new terrain types, which include jungle, desert, forest, and tundra. Full list of changes below!

- New Terrain Types

- New Terrain Leader Traits

- New Leader Trait called "The Great", which is a less common trait that gives nations all of the benefits of the conqueror, expansionist and uniter traits.

- Fixed issue with marker cursor setting

- New Terrain Map Mode for a more colorful look at the new terrain types

- New Terrain Types added to map maker

- New West Africa map, which includes some of the new terrain types

Currently only the new West Africa map has the new terrain types, but I am planning on gradually updating the other maps to have the new terrain also. I'm also thinking about adding an additional beach terrain type, which would include a coastal raider leader trait to go with it. As always, there's more to come, and please post about any bugs or issues with the game  on Discord, itch.io or Steam :)

notes.title: Restructuring Update!
notes.content:
This update restructures how some of the base mechanics I made early on in development function. Everything will work the same as it did before, but with less bugs along the way. I also updated The save/load system, and I’m hoping it will result in less issues for the users who were reporting their games crashing while saving or loading a game. There’s perhaps still some work to do on the save/load system (I personally noticed a slight stutter in frames when saving/loading a game), but I’m hoping that this new system will be better in the long run. Below are the changes I mentioned already, and a couple others.

[list]
[*] New Save/Load System
[*] Nations/Faiths being renamed to “Nothing_To_See_Here” Fixed
[*] Possible fix for the drawing with castles bug (I myself have never been able to replicate the bug, but I’ve tried adding a solution for what I think is happening. Lmk if that hasn’t worked)
[*] New South Asia Map!!
[/list]

What’s Next? I’ll be trying to fix any immediate bugs people are experiencing after this update, but after that I wanna work on actual changes to the game. I’m thinking of new leader traits, a fourth bigger brush size, updates to the map selection menu, and more. I’ll expand on that a bit later down the line, but for now I hope you enjoy the update and as always let me know about any bugs you’ve experienced. I’ll do my best to fix them :)

notes.title: Update News!! (Update not out yet)
notes.content: [p]​The Update is not out yet, but I wanna go ahead and give a warning that the next update will have some restructuring to how nation data is stored, which will make any old saves unplayable and broken. Along with that I’m also updating the save/load system to hopefully make saving and loading more stable and less likely to crash or load forever, and with this comes a new save file type. With those two things in mind, I will be setting it up so that the old broken save files will not show up in your saves list in game once the update arrives. This means that if you have any worlds that you’re currently playing on you should enjoy them while you can for now, because they unfortunately won’t be playable once I put the next update out. I would recommend taking screenshots of your worlds if you’re really attached to any of them. I apologize for the inconvenience, and apologies for how long it’s taking for this next update to be finished as well. I’m going to try to get the update out within a week or so, but my schedule has been a bit busy in general for the past month with Doodle Empires and my other responsibilities. I have a few more things to fix and some more testing to do, but if we get through this small hurdle I’m hoping the game will be more stable for more people in the long run. Thank you for your understanding, and thank you to everyone who has played the early access release of Doodle Empires. The game is doing incredibly well compared to what I was expecting, and I’m very grateful to everyone in the community for supporting my silly map game[/p][p][/p][p]Also p.s. a new India map is also in the works![/p]
